description: XDR Platform Operations Hardening — stream lag, queue backlog, replay pressure, retention, backup, degraded services. Advisory metrics only. No autonomous remediation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, consumer_group || '/' || topic AS metric, lag_count AS value FROM queue_lag_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY time ASC
SELECT created_at AS time, consumer_group AS metric, lag_count AS value FROM queue_lag_metrics WHERE trend = 'increasing' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY time
SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS count FROM stream_pressure_metrics WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY state
SELECT created_at AS time, service_name AS metric, value FROM stream_pressure_metrics WHERE metric_type = 'replay_pressure' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY time
SELECT AVG(value) AS value FROM stream_pressure_metrics WHERE metric_type = 'saturation' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'

SELECT re.created_at, rp.domain, re.dry_run, re.rows_eligible, re.rows_deleted, re.status FROM retention_executions re JOIN retention_policies rp ON rp.id = re.policy_id WHERE $__timeFilter(re.created_at) ORDER BY re.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT rv.created_at, rv.backup_id, rv.validation_type, rv.result FROM recovery_validations rv WHERE $__timeFilter(rv.created_at) ORDER BY rv.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT s1.service_name, s1.health_state, s1.error_message, s1.created_at FROM service_health_snapshots s1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_health_snapshots s2 WHERE s2.service_name = s1.service_name AND s2.id > s1.id) AND s1.health_state != 'healthy' ORDER BY s1.service_name

SELECT created_at AS time, job_id AS metric, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (updated_at - created_at)) AS duration_seconds FROM dlq_replay_jobs WHERE status = 'completed' AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY time

title: XDR Operations Hardening
